Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.classes

Class ClassAbilityProcEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixGameEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.classes.ClassAbilityProcEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public final class ClassAbilityProcEvent extends ZentrixGameEvent implements org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
Called when a built-in class ability triggers, after Zentrix decided it applies - the class, the match state and, for chance-based abilities, the roll - and before its effect happens.

Listeners can cancel the effect entirely, change its strength through setMagnitude(double) where getMagnitude() is present, replace the item it hands out where getItem() is present, or keep the ability's currency reward from being paid without touching the effect itself. A cancelled proc pays no reward either.

What each proc carries
ProcMagnitudeItemTarget
ClassAbilityProcEvent.Proc.TRUE_DAMAGEbonus damage, dealt a tick later-the victim
ClassAbilityProcEvent.Proc.BOW_SHOT_BUFF--the entity hit
ClassAbilityProcEvent.Proc.CHEST_BONUS-the bonus item added to the container-
ClassAbilityProcEvent.Proc.FALL_DAMAGE_REDUCTIONthe fraction of fall damage prevented, 0 to 1--
ClassAbilityProcEvent.Proc.EXTRA_CATCH-the extra copy of the catch dropped-
ClassAbilityProcEvent.Proc.MINERAL_DROP-the mineral dropped-
ClassAbilityProcEvent.Proc.AUTO_SMELT-the smelted result given instead of the ore's drops-

Main thread; only fired while a listener is registered.

Since:
1.8.0
